stories.title: Bomb threats divert more than a dozen flights across Europe
stories.summary: More than a dozen passenger flights made emergency landings across Europe on Thursday after a second wave of bomb threats this week, with fighter jets escorting some planes. No explosives have been found so far.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
stories.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo, 41, announced his retirement from international football, ending a record 234-cap Portugal career that included a Euro 2016 title and two Nations League crowns.

stories.title: Microsoft reportedly scraps multibillion-dollar AI deal with UK's nscale
stories.summary: Microsoft walked away from a multibillion-dollar AI cloud deal with UK firm nscale, the FT reported, the latest sign big tech is reining in AI data-center spending commitments.

stories.title: China blocks SoftBank's $5.4B takeover of ABB robotics unit
stories.summary: China blocked SoftBank's $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB's industrial robotics unit, another rejection of a foreign tech deal amid intensifying competition over AI and automation.

stories.title: Nintendo quarterly profit drops 16% on Switch 2 costs
stories.summary: Nintendo reported a 16% year-over-year drop in quarterly net profit to $468 million, as rising Switch 2 component costs squeezed margins while hardware sales slowed.

stories.title: OpenAI pledges data-center deal changes after voter backlash
stories.summary: OpenAI said it will stop using non-disclosure agreements in data-center negotiations and ensure residents don't pay for its power, responding to midterm backlash over AI infrastructure.

stories.title: Ohio State lands at No. 12 in first CFP rankings
stories.summary: Ohio State debuted at No. 12 in the first College Football Playoff rankings of 2026 after Saturday's loss to USC, leaving no margin for error entering its home game against Oregon.

stories.title: Belgian firm to take over Renault/Alpine's Viry engine facility
stories.summary: Renault agreed to sell its Viry-Chatillon engine facility — long the home of its Formula 1 power-unit program — to Belgium's Dumarey Group, closing a chapter in Alpine's engine history.

stories.title: 1 critically injured in overnight north Columbus shooting
stories.summary: One person was seriously injured in an overnight shooting in north Columbus, and police said an investigation into the incident is ongoing.

stories.title: Columbus man charged with murder in northeast-side shooting
stories.summary: A Columbus man was charged with murder after a 25-year-old woman was killed and another injured in a Wednesday morning shooting on the city's northeast side.
